description: List the starter templates available to vibekit_create_app (e.g. landing, dashboard, blog, saas, crud-api). Call this before vibekit_create_app to choose a valid template.
name: vibekit_list_templates

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of starter templates with name and description.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit List Templates
